content:
rachel (CISO): Wehave a POC next week. Security needs: 1) audit log exports to Splunk HEC, 2) KMS-backed keys, 3) roster of users with console/API access, 4) revocation proof. POC 30 days, ~100 rps.

ben (AE): Thanks @rachel. Looping @ada + @omar. Preferred: Splunk HEC + 1yr retention.

ada (Solutions): Two fast paths: Hosted + HEC forwarding (minutes) or Dedicated ephemeral pool (hours-days). By default we keep in-house audits 90d; export to your Splunk/S3 for longer. Send HEC URL + token and we'll enable forwarding. Example HEC config (sanitized):

```
audit_export:\n  type: splunk_hec\n  endpoint: https://splunk.corp:8088/services/collector\n  token: <redacted>\n  format: json_lines
```

omar (Security): We'll provide a sanitized JSONL sample and a field spec (event_type, actor, key_id, action, result, ts, audit_id). Revocation example:

```
# revoke key
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/keys/revoke \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>" -d '{"key_id":"k_42"}'
```

Corresponding audit event: {"event_type":"api_key.revoke","actor":"admin@acme","key_id":"k_42","timestamp":"2026-03-01T13:05:00Z","audit_id":"ae_42"}

infra-bot: provision job queued id=prov-12345 ETA~30m

ben (AE): Rachel, please DM HEC creds + roster CSV. We'll send a short POC security pack (SOC2 link, KMS doc, sample export).

rachel (CISO): Will DM creds today. Thanks everyone.

ada (Solutions): Once creds received we'll wire HEC and upload sanitized sample. infra-bot will post when pool ready.

infra-bot: provision complete id=prov-12345 status=success pool=dedicated-temp-12345

ben (AE): Action items: rachel-> HEC + roster; ada-> wire forwarding + sample; omar-> field spec + revocation note. Follow-up meeting scheduled after artifacts. :white_check_mark:
